posts.description:
A room full of builders. One challenge: make two AI agents work as a team.

Diwali Festiverse's SF hackathon kicked off in San Francisco, hosted by Crewbase Collective.

Laptops open. People gathered around shared screens. Conversations across the table.
The task: build two AI agents that communicate, delegate tasks and work together.

As a co-founder, I want our work at AI House and HiDevs to create more spaces like this. Places where people can find others to build with and put their ideas to the test.

The SF kickoff is one part of that work, with builders at the centre.
Building Festiverse with Deepak Chawla, Saurabh Khire alongside Crewbase Collective, AI House - Bangalore and HiDevs .

Festiverse sponsors: Lyzr AI • AdaL • Finch • BAND • Agent 37 (YC F26)
Sponsor teams: Arick Goomanovsky, Li Yin, Gary Yang , Siva Surendira and Vishnu Krishnaprasad.

posts.description:
Another week and another update on a fast startup life:
We hosted our first dinner in San Francisco! On AI adoption!
Leaders from Lyft, TaskRabbit, Freshworks, Abridge and others joined!

So what did we hear?

1. Most leaders come up with AI workflows by experimenting themselves! They think ‘imagination’ is the key skill.

2. Leaders can be far away from the ‘day to day work’ which makes it hard for them to identify and build useful AI workflows.

3. Trainings are old fashioned, and it is not working for AI.

4. There is a serious expectation for the new hires to be AI native from day one! Not an easy task to fulfill!

5. Being ‘mostly accurate’ for an AI tool is not enough for regulated industries which really hinders the adoption.

6. And unfortunately… the fear of being left behind and be replaced by AI... 

I picked a Turkish restaurant, so there was plenty of cultural chat among the AI chat :)

Well, what are your takes on these?

How do you come up with AI workflows for your team? Do you ask Claude?

If you are looking for a job, how do you feel about the ‘AI native’ request?…

What do you think is the best way to train on AI?

And… if you are interested joining the next AI adoption dinner, we’re currently planning for big cities in the US, please DM me!

--
Thank you for your time and presense! Alisa Liebowitz Chris Lambert Kanishka Thakur Kalia Waits-Smith ⛸️ Dilek Barlow Gurtej Gill Bethel Zelalem, MSOD, PMP Kevin Law Sameer Shariff

So I'm paying sales force $1,000,000 a year. Why don't they pay Chammas like crappy Salesforce $100,000 a year? And we have seen the complete opposite from our estimates. We see our customers. They are happy to pay us actually more for their existing software. Yeah, way more because it's not about cost saving, it's all about revenue generation. And so coming back to this straight forward that we keep talking about, he was running his business and he's doing an at ten, $20 million of revenue. If your core business operations run way faster because you have software that's designed for your business, your revenue goes up and so.
